title: 第14章 初尝少女
content_zh:
闵嘉庚听了一会，心中暗暗好笑：“这老头说得狗屁不通！跟人打架，哪有牢牢记住这拳是虚、那脚是实的道理。我这拳明明是虚，忽然变作了实，有何不可？你以为我这脚是实，快快闪避，我见你一避，实变为虚，下一脚你以为定是虚了，不闪不避，我偏偏变作了实，狠狠在你屁股上一踹，你不跌个狗吃屎才怪？”

    闵嘉庚早知自己的家传武功比岳胜高出百倍，饶是这位海安物流老板名闻江湖，说什么百胜拳，只要自己跟他一动手，三拳两脚就能把他打倒在地，爬不起来。这时听他向三个后辈一说拳脚之道，拘泥不化，更知他武功甚为有限，做物流生意这么久没给人打死，当真运气好得很了。

    其实岳胜也非运气奇佳，他的武功确实造诣不凡，只因闵嘉庚自己学到了天下一等一的神功，常言道：登泰山而小天下。他不知自己已登上了泰山，一眼望出来见到群山低矮，便诧异不已，却是他的见识小了。

    岳胜教了好一会，便命三人试招。周银兵和温文新倒是真打，温文新武功根底远比周银兵高，通臂连拳虽是初学，但他趁着岳胜不在意时，忽然使出万澜集团的威风激穿拳夹在通臂连拳中，周银兵莫名其妙连中几拳，鼻子流血，便退了开去。岳青跟着再上，温文新故意容让，给她的粉拳打了几下，见岳青一脚扫来，大叫一声哎呦，她脚未扫到，温文新已先摔倒在地，岳青这脚才踢到他腿上。

    周银兵大声说：“我不练啦！你跟少堡主真真假假的玩吧！”转身出林。岳胜脸色阴沉，嘿嘿两声，跟着离去。温文新有心要留下来跟岳青说一会话，岳青却说：“少堡主，你先回去吧。我歇一会再来。”温文新应了声：“好！”见她脸色郑重，不敢违拗，便跟着岳胜父子回堡。

    岳青舒了几口气，自己展开拳脚，练了一会查拳。闵嘉庚躲在草丛中，见岳青身形婀娜，一拳打出，袖子上褪，露出半段手臂，雪禁品嫩，浑圆如玉，闵嘉庚想多看一会，她袖子垂落下来将手臂遮住了。只见岳青左腿高高踢出，足尖几乎过顶，裤筒垂下来，露出她小腿的一段白肉。闵嘉庚这时才十几岁，还不能明白男女之意，但情窦初开，已知欣赏女子的美色。岳青青春美艳，十八九岁年纪，身材丰满，皮肤白皙，虽非绝色美女，但艳丽非凡，不论哪个男子见到，都忍不住要多瞧一眼。闵嘉庚见到了她手臂和小腿的白肉，不禁从草丛中长起半个身子，要想瞧得更清楚一些。

    岳青练了一会查拳，喘气重了，觉得倦了，见四下无人，仰天一摔，躺在草地上，轻轻哼起小曲：“让我变成美丽的骏马，和你驰骋在天涯。一起守护古老的神话和传说，永不凋落。摘朵美丽的晚霞，让它盛开在天涯。我的心被融化，梦想就会到达……”声音娇柔婉转。闵嘉庚一生中从来没听到过这般销魂蚀骨的甜美情歌，情不自禁伸出手去，拉住了一株灌木的树枝。那树枝坚硬有刺，荆刺刺入他的掌心，闵嘉庚竟不觉得，似乎自己握住了岳青的小手，正在听她温柔款款地叮嘱：“让我变成美丽的骏马，和你驰骋在天涯……”

    他只盼岳青跟着唱下去，唱的是几句缠绵深情的情话，却听岳青口齿模糊，重复着只唱：“让我变成美丽的骏马，和你驰骋在天涯……”再唱几句，歌声变成了轻轻的鼾声，天时温暖，她出力练了拳脚后，竟在草地上睡着了。

    闵嘉庚从草丛中轻轻爬出，站在岳青身旁，只见她双臂放在身侧，仰天而睡，一丛黑发散在脑后，额头有几粒细细的汗珠，双眼闭住、长长的睫毛微微颤动，笔挺的鼻子下是张樱桃小口，嘴唇轻轻颤抖。闵嘉庚胸中一股强烈冲动，便想扑上去在她的小口上咬上一口，立即转身便逃，一跃上树，料想她即使立即醒来，也认不出自己，追不上自己。

    这只是一时的孩子气想法，他无论如何不敢。心想：“青姐知觉后，既不理我，也不打我，只是一把将我推开，一句话也不说，回去跟他们告状。我回到温家堡去，大家见我便大笑，刮着脸羞我，那可如何是好？我只好投河自尽，人也不要做了，辉哥也不敢见了！”他站在岳青身旁，只见她高耸的胸部随着呼吸而起伏，向下瞧去，见她打底衫耸了上来，露出两三寸白嫩的肚腹。他不敢再向下看了，眼光上望，见到她最上面的三颗纽扣已经解开，露出白嫩的头颈和深深的乳沟，颈中挂着条细细的黄金项链，垂向胸前。

    闵嘉庚的心砰砰乱跳，似乎听到了自己心跳的声音，心中只想：“青姐要是肯让我亲亲她的脸，亲亲她雪白的头颈，不推开我，不笑我，不论要我做什么都可以。我肯变成只小狗，伏在她脚边……她要跟她爸爸运货，不管有多凶狠的强人来劫货，都由我去打发。她爸武功不行，她哥更不行，那少堡主也没用，只有我闵嘉庚能为她出力，就算有一千个一百个武功挺高的强人，也只有我能护她周全。强人将我砍得周身是伤，但终于给我杀退了，青姐拉着我的手，唱着‘让我变成美丽的骏马，和你驰骋在天涯……’她摸着我全身流血的伤口，流着眼泪说：‘好弟弟，你为我受这么多伤，杀退了强人，我不知怎么报答你才好……’”

    他痴痴望着岳青樱红的小嘴，满脑子胡思乱想。突然只见那小嘴缓缓张开，嘴角边显现娇媚的微笑，露出两排雪白晶莹的牙齿，幽幽叹了口长气。闵嘉庚只觉这微笑说不出的好看，他完全不懂，这是女子在思念情郎的笑容。只见她双臂伸起，虚搂着空中的一个幻影，双袖下垂，露出两条雪白的胳膊。

    闵嘉庚大惊，急忙转身，飞步疾奔，到了一株大松树下，一跃而起，踏上枝干，藏身枝叶间。只见岳青坐起身来，跟着站起，嘴里轻轻哼着：“啦啦啦啦啦……啦啦啦啦啦……暖暖的阳光，九天外马琴悠扬，是最耀眼的光芒……”一边低唱，一边慢慢出林去了。他可不知，在岳青心中全没半点闵嘉庚这个小屁孩的身影。她不会梦到温文新，也不会梦到周银兵，她梦到的，是那日在戏台上见到的那个扮相俊雅、满身锦绣、眉清目秀的贵公子。

    岳胜年老血亏，晚上睡得不沉。这日三更，忽听墙外喀喇一响，是谁无意中踏断了一根枯枝。岳老板一生闯荡江湖，声一入耳，即知有夜行人在屋外经过，但只这么一响，再无声息，竟听不出那人是向东向西，还是躲在墙上窥伺。他虽在温家堡作客，但主人于己有恩，平日相待情意深厚，他已把温家堡的安危瞧得跟自己家的一般重，当下悄悄爬起，从枕底取出金丝软鞭缠在腰间，轻轻打开房门，跃上墙头，突见堡外黑影晃动，有人奔向后山。

    他一瞥之下，见此人轻功颇为了得，心下寻思：“莫非那曹虎心犹未死，又来作怪？此事由我身上而起，我岂能袖手？”当即跃出墙外，脚下加快，向那黑影去路急追，奔出数十丈，却已不见了黑影的踪迹，心中一动：“不好，别要中了敌人的调虎离山计。”急忙飞步扑回温家堡。但听四下里寂静无声，稍感放心，但疑云又起：“适才此人身手不凡，实是劲敌。但瞧他身形瘦小，与曹虎大不相同，不知是江湖上什么好手到了？”

    他抓住软鞭，在掌上盘了几转，弓身向堡后走去，要察看个究竟。蹿出十余丈，将到尽头，忽听西首隐隐有金刃劈风之声，他暗叫一声：“惭愧，果然有人来袭，却不知跟谁动上了手？”双足一点，身形纵起。岳老板年纪虽老，身手仍极矫捷，左手在墙头一搭，一个倒翻身，轻轻落在墙内，循声过去，听声音是从后进的一间砖屋中发出。但说也奇怪，二人一味哑斗，既没半声吆喝叫骂，武器亦不碰撞。他心知中间必有蹊跷，先不冲进相助，凑眼到窗缝中一望，不禁险些失笑。

    但见屋中空空荡荡，桌上一灯如豆，两个人各执钢刀，盘旋来去激斗，一个是少主人温文新，另一个却是他母亲温老太，母子俩正在练习刀法。

    他只瞧了片刻，不由倒抽一口凉气，只见温老太出手狠辣，刀法精妙，固与日间的龙钟老态大不相同，而温文新一路八卦刀法使出来也虎虎生风。原来非但温老太平时深藏不露，温文新也是故意隐瞒了武功。他平日教温文新的只是拳脚，刀法自己并不擅长，温文新也从来不提，想不到这青年武器上的造诣着实不低。
content_en:
Min Jiageng listened for a while and secretly laughed in his heart: "What this old man said makes no sense! When fighting, how can you keep in mind that this punch is empty and that kick is real? My punch was obviously empty, but suddenly it became real, why not?" You thought my kick was solid, so you quickly dodge. When I saw you dodge, the solid turned into a weak one. The next kick you thought was a weak one. If you don't dodge, I turned into a solid one and kicked you hard on your ass. Is it weird that you don't fall like a dog and eat shit?"

    Min Jiageng had known that his ancestral martial arts skills were a hundred times better than Yue Sheng's, but the Haian Logistics boss was famous all over the world. He said Yu Sheng Fist, as long as he attacked him, he could knock him to the ground with three punches and two kicks, making him unable to get up. At this time, I heard him talking about the art of boxing and kicking to three juniors, but he was rigid and rigid. I also learned that his martial arts was very limited. He was really lucky to have been in the logistics business without being beaten to death for so long.

    In fact, Yue Sheng was not unlucky. His martial arts achievements were indeed extraordinary, just because Min Jiageng himself learned the best magical skills in the world. As the saying goes: Climbing Mount Tai will make the world smaller. He didn't know that he had climbed Mount Tai. He was surprised to see the low mountains at a glance, but he was short-sighted.

    Yue Sheng taught for a while and then ordered the three of them to try the moves. Zhou Yinbing and Wen Wenxin were really fighting. Wen Wenxin's martial arts foundation was much higher than Zhou Yinbing's. Although he was a beginner in the through-arm combo, when Yue Sheng was not paying attention, he suddenly used the Wanlan Group's majestic piercing fist and sandwiched it between the through-arm combo. Zhou Yinbing inexplicably received several punches in a row, causing his nose to bleed, and he retreated. Yue Qing followed, Wen Wenxin deliberately gave way and gave her a few punches. Seeing Yue Qing's kick, he yelled "Ouch". Wen Wenxin had already fallen to the ground before her foot was swept, and it was only then that Yue Qing's kick hit his leg.

    Zhou Yinbing said loudly: "I won't practice anymore! You and the young castle master can play it real and fake!" He turned around and walked out of the forest. Yue Sheng's face was gloomy, hey hey twice, and left. Wen Wenxin wanted to stay and talk to Yue Qing, but Yue Qing said, "Young Lord, please go back first. I will rest for a while and come back." Wen Wenxin responded: "Okay!" Seeing her serious face, he did not dare to disobey, so he followed Yue Sheng and his son back to the castle.

    Yue Qing breathed a few sighs of relief, spread out his fists and feet, and practiced Cha Quan for a while. Min Jiageng was hiding in the grass and saw Yue Qing's graceful figure. He punched her and her sleeves fell off, revealing half of her arm. She was as tender as snow and as round as jade. Min Jiageng wanted to take a closer look, so her sleeves fell down to cover her arms. I saw Yue Qing's left leg kicked out high, her toes almost reaching her top, and her trousers hanging down, revealing a section of white flesh on her calf. Min Jiageng was only a teenager at this time and could not yet understand the meaning of men and women, but he had just begun to have a love interest and he already knew how to appreciate the beauty of women. Yue Qing was young and beautiful, eighteen or nineteen years old, with a plump figure and fair skin. Although she was not a stunning beauty, she was so gorgeous that no matter which man saw her, he couldn't help but take a second look at her. Min Jiageng saw the white flesh of her arms and calves, and couldn't help but grow half of his body out of the grass to get a better look.

    Yue Qing practiced Cha Quan for a while, was out of breath, and felt tired. Seeing no one around, he threw himself up and lay on the grass, humming a ditty softly: "Let me become a beautiful horse and gallop with you in the end of the world. Together, we will protect the ancient myths and legends and never wither. Pick a beautiful sunset and let it bloom in the end of the world. My heart will be melted, and my dream will arrive..." The voice is soft and graceful. Min Jiageng had never heard such a soul-crushing sweet love song in his life. He couldn't help but stretched out his hand and pulled the branch of a shrub. The branch was hard and thorny, and the thorns pierced his palm. Min Jiageng didn't feel that he was holding Yue Qing's little hand and listening to her gentle instructions: "Let me turn into a beautiful horse and gallop with you to the end of the world..."

    He only expected Yue Qing to continue singing along, singing a few lingering and affectionate love words, but he heard Yue Qing's speech was blurred, and she only sang repeatedly: "Let me become a beautiful horse, galloping with you in the end of the world..." After singing a few more lines, the song turned into a gentle snoring. The weather was warm, and after she practiced boxing and kicking hard, she actually fell asleep on the grass.

    Min Jiageng crawled out from the grass gently and stood next to Yue Qing. He saw her lying on her back with her arms on her sides, a clump of black hair scattered behind her head, a few beads of sweat on her forehead, her eyes closed, her long eyelashes trembling slightly, a small cherry mouth under her straight nose, and her lips trembling slightly. Min Jiageng felt a strong impulse in his chest and wanted to pounce on her and bite her. He immediately turned around and ran away, jumping up the tree. He expected that even if she woke up immediately, she would not be able to recognize him or catch up with him.

    This was just a childish thought, and he didn't dare to do it anyway. I thought: "After Sister Qing realized it, she neither ignored me nor hit me. She just pushed me away without saying a word and went back to complain to them. When I returned to Wenjiapu, everyone laughed when they saw me and shaved their faces to shame me. What should I do? I have no choice but to commit suicide by drowning myself in the river, and I don’t want to do it anymore, and Brother Hui won’t dare to see her anymore!” He stood beside Yue Qing, and saw her tall chest rising and falling with her breathing. Looking down, he saw her bottom shirt lifted up, revealing two or three inches of her white and tender belly. He didn't dare to look down anymore. He looked up and saw that her top three buttons had been undone, revealing her white and tender neck and deep cleavage. A thin gold necklace hung around her neck, hanging down to her chest.

    Min Jiageng's heart was beating wildly, and he seemed to hear the sound of his own heartbeat. He just thought: "If Sister Qing is willing to let me kiss her face, kiss her snow-white head and neck, and don't push me away or laugh at me, no matter what you want me to do, you can do it." So. I am willing to turn into a puppy and lie down at her feet... She wants to transport goods with her father. No matter how fierce the strongman comes to rob the goods, I will take care of her. Her father is not good at martial arts, and her brother is not good at it. The young castle master is useless. I am the only one. Min Jiageng could help her. Even if there were a thousand strong men with high martial arts skills, I was the only one who could protect her. The strong man slashed me with wounds all over my body, but I finally fought back. Sister Qing held my hand and sang, "Let me." Turn into a beautiful horse and gallop with you to the end of the world...' She touched the bleeding wounds all over my body and said with tears: 'Good brother, you suffered so many injuries for me and defeated the strong man. I don't know how to repay you...'"

    He stared blankly at Yue Qingying's red mouth, his mind filled with random thoughts. Suddenly, the small mouth slowly opened, a charming smile appeared at the corner of the mouth, revealing two rows of snow-white teeth, and he let out a long sigh. Min Jiageng thought this smile was indescribably beautiful. He didn't understand it at all. It was the smile of a woman who was missing her lover. I saw her arms stretched out, hugging a phantom in the air, her sleeves drooping, revealing two snow-white arms.

    Min Jiageng was shocked, turned around quickly, and ran quickly. He reached the foot of a big pine tree, jumped up, stepped on the branches, and hid among the leaves. I saw Yue Qing sitting up, then standing up, humming softly: "La la la la la... la la la la la... the warm sunshine, the melodious music of the maqin nine days away, is the most dazzling light..." Singing in a low voice, he slowly left the forest. Little did he know that in Yue Qing's heart, there was no trace of the little kid Min Jiageng. She would not dream about Wen Wenxin, nor Zhou Yinbing. What she dreamed about was the elegant, handsome, and handsome young man she saw on the stage that day.

    Yue Sheng was old and losing blood, so he couldn't sleep deeply at night. At three o'clock that day, I suddenly heard a click outside the wall. Someone accidentally stepped on a dead branch. Boss Yue has traveled all his life, and as soon as he hears the sound, he knows that someone is passing by at night outside the house. However, there is only such a sound, and there is no sound again. It is impossible to tell whether the person is heading east or west, or is hiding on the wall and watching. Although he was a guest in Wenjiapu, his master was kind to him and treated him with deep affection. He valued the safety of Wenjiapu as much as his own home. He quietly got up, took out a soft gold whip from under the pillow and wrapped it around his waist. He opened the door gently, jumped up to the wall, and suddenly saw a dark shadow outside the fort shaking, and someone running towards the back hill.

    At a glance, he saw that this man had gained quite a lot in his Qing Gong, and he thought to himself: "Could it be that Cao Hu's heart is still alive, and he is causing trouble again? This happened to me, how could I stand still?" He immediately jumped out of the wall, accelerated his steps, and chased the black shadow. He ran for tens of feet, but there was no trace of the black shadow. He thought in his mind: "No, don't fall into the enemy's plan to lure the tiger away from the mountain." He quickly rushed back to Wenjiabao. But hearing that there was silence all around, I felt a little relieved, but doubts arose again: "This person Shicai has extraordinary skills and is really a strong enemy. But seeing that he is thin and small, he is very different from Cao Hu. I wonder if some good person in the world has arrived?"

    He grabbed the soft whip, twisted it in his palm a few times, and walked towards the back of the castle to see what was going on. He jumped more than ten feet and was about to reach the end when he suddenly heard the faint sound of a golden blade chopping the wind in the west. He screamed secretly: "I'm ashamed, someone is really coming, but I don't know who they started with?" He stepped up with his feet and stood up. Although Boss Yue was old, he was still very agile. He put his left hand on the wall, turned over and landed gently on the wall. He followed the sound and found that the sound came from a brick house behind him. But it is strange to say that the two of them just fought in silence, without shouting or cursing, and their weapons did not collide. He knew there must be something fishy going on, so instead of rushing in to help, he looked through the crack in the window and almost laughed.

    But the room was empty, with a lamp like a bean on the table. Two people, each holding a steel knife, were circling and fighting fiercely. One was the young master Wen Wenxin, and the other was his mother, Mrs. Wen. The mother and son were practicing their sword skills.

    He only looked at it for a moment, and couldn't help but gasp. He saw that Mrs. Wen's attacks were fierce and her sword skills were exquisite. They were very different from the old Long Zhong in the day. Wen Wenxin's Bagua sword skills were also very powerful. It turns out that not only Mrs. Wen usually hides her secrets, but Wen Wenxin also deliberately conceals his martial arts. He usually taught Wen Wenxin only fists and kicks. He was not good at swordsmanship, and Wen Wenxin never mentioned it. Unexpectedly, this young man was very accomplished in weapons.
